moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: An employee of its employer; optional
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 其雇主的一名员工；可选

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 已结束的工资项及其条款保留，不再用于新结构。仍在使用它的结构须先在那里结束。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: An ended structure is kept and offered for no new assignment.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 已结束的结构保留，不再用于新的分派。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: An external processor's group is never calculated here: its inputs are exported and its results imported in Payroll exchange

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: An external processor's group is never calculated here: its inputs are exported and its results imported in Payroll exchange; it needs no localization to be live
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 外部处理方的工资组从不在此计算：其输入导出，其结果在工资交换中导入；它无需属地核算即可实发

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: An identity document's or work permit's number is read only by you and HR
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 身份证件或工作许可的号码仅您和人力资源可以阅读

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: An opening recruits for approved, active seats of one employer: a planned seat is approved first. Applicants are never public before a careers page exists.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 职位空缺为一个雇主已批准且有效的席位招聘：计划中的席位须先批准。在招聘页面存在之前，应聘者从不公开。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Applications are open to the recruiters of an employer. An interviewer opens the applications of their interviews from Interviews.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 申请对雇主的招聘人员开放。面试官从“面试”打开其面试的申请。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Approval rules are the People administrator's.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 审批规则属于 People 管理员。

Approved hours, leave, pieces and payroll claims of ${runInfo.periodText} become pay inputs once; an employee with time to approve or attendance to resolve is left out and named.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: ${runInfo.periodText} 已批准的工时、休假、计件和工资报销只进入一次计薪输入；仍有工时待批或出勤待解决的员工被排除并列出。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Approved, active seats of the employer
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 雇主已批准且有效的席位
审批人可以覆盖被阻止的日期

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Approving finalizes the review; the reviewer then releases it to the person.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 批准即定稿该评估；之后评估人将其发布给本人。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Ask for time off, follow your requests and decide your team's.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 申请休假，跟踪您的申请，并决定您团队的申请。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: At or before From: the next day
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 等于或早于开始时间：次日
阻止或强制 ${policy.organizationName} 的日期

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 被阻止的日期拒绝休假，或允许审批人覆盖；强制日期由所有人使用。已批准的休假不取消。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: By an external processor: its results are imported in Payroll exchange
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 由外部处理方：其结果在工资交换中导入

取消 ${fromDay} 至 ${thruDay} 的日期

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Cancelled at once: what was taken is given back and the days are freed. The person is told.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 立即取消：已使用的额度退回，日期释放。已通知本人。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Certificates, licences, degrees and documents, verified and kept valid.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 证书、执照、学位和文件，经核验并保持有效。
更改 ${personName} 在 ${organizationName} 的经理
更改自 ${serviceMonthsFrom} 个月起的步骤

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Changed terms make the offer a draft again: it is submitted for approval again.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 条款变更使录用通知再次成为草稿：须再次送审。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Choose a pay group and one of its prepared periods to reconcile its hours before a pay run.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 选择一个工资组及其一个已准备期间，以便在发薪批次之前核对工时。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Choose a person to preview their days.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 选择一个人以预览其日期。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Choose a person who already works for or applied to the employer, or name a new applicant; an address someone already has finds them, so no one is made twice.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 选择已为该雇主工作或已申请的人，或填写新应聘者；已有的地址会找到此人，因此不会重复创建。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Choose an employee, or a department, or neither for every current employee of ${policy.organizationName}. Someone under another ${policy.leaveTypeText} policy then is named and left out.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 选择一名员工、一个部门，或不选以包括 ${policy.organizationName} 的每位在职员工。当时已在另一 ${policy.leaveTypeText} 政策下的人会被列出并排除。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Choose the person, or give a new person's first and last names
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 请选择此人，或填写新人员的名和姓

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Choose the policy to allocate under.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 请选择要在其下分配的政策。
已建立报销 ${made.invoiceId}：请添加您的费用

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Claim what you spent for work, with its receipts, and follow it to payment.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 报销因工作产生的支出并附收据，并跟踪到付款。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Click a cell to record an evaluation.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 点击单元格以记录一次考核。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Clocking is not on for your employment: HR turns it on where your work is recorded by the clock.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您的雇佣未开启打卡：人力资源在以时钟记录工作的地方开启它。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Clocking of ${personName} as the employer's default
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 将 ${personName} 的打卡设为雇主默认

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Confidential cases: only you and the case handlers your employer names read them, never your manager or HR.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 保密案件：只有您和雇主指定的案件处理人可以阅读，您的经理和人力资源不能。
更正 ${personName} 的已定稿调整
更正 ${day.personName} 在 ${day.attendanceDate} 的出勤

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Correction asked: it waits for approval
Correction run made: calculate it and ask for approval
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 已建立更正批次：请计算并请求批准

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Decides when no one of the role may
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 当该角色无人可以决定时由谁决定

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Departments and teams under each employer you read, as of a date. Open a unit for its parents and members.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您可以阅读的每个雇主下的部门和团队，截至某一日期。打开单位可看其上级和成员。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Draft a job description for this role from its job class: the purpose, the main responsibilities, the skills it requires and what it offers, in plain words
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 根据此角色的职类起草职位说明：目的、主要职责、所需技能和所提供的条件，用通俗的话

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Dragging shifts is in the browser's roster; Shift here previews and saves the same change.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 拖动班次在浏览器的排班表中；此处的“班次”预览并保存同一变更。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 每位员工现行的薪酬条款，以及仍阻止预览批次的事项。薪金在员工记录上以薪酬变更的方式修改。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Each employer's People preferences; every change is kept with its reason.

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 每个工资组的日历和薪酬政策。此处工资仅为预览：在属地核算覆盖之前，任何组都不能实发。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Each pending, failed or changed employee is calculated on its own; one in error is named and the others go on. A long run is calculated in parts: calculate again to go on. Nothing is paid or posted.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 每位待处理、失败或已变更的员工单独计算；出错的列出，其余继续。较长的批次分段计算：再次计算以继续。不支付也不过账。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Each row is checked again, and the totals compared with what the sender signed off. Nothing is made.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 每一行再次核对，合计与发送方签认的内容比较。不生成任何内容。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Employees in error are fixed and calculated again, or excluded with a reason, before approval.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 出错的员工在批准前更正并重新计算，或附原因排除。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Employees of the employer with an account: each answers their own scorecard
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 有账号的雇主员工：每人填写自己的记分卡

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 按雇主的雇佣、按月入职、按类型的已休休假和按到期的资质，限于每位查看者可读的组织。只有数量和天数：无薪酬、私人联系方式或保密记录。
空表示无固定结束的雇佣

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 空表示仅一次；否则直到此日期每个发薪期间一笔调整

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 空：某个部门的，或雇主的每位员工

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 每次分派，或仅选用它的分派（例如自愿养老金）

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 该休假类型的每个余额都记在其中

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 空则包括您可读的每位雇主

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 其中每个名额都取消，等待审批的名额从其审批人处撤回。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 说明我的休假余额：已授予、已应计、已使用和已预留的，以及剩余

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Files shared with the interview panel
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 与面试小组共享的文件

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 定稿等待人力资源批准，除非审批规则另有规定

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 对于您工作但没有打卡的一天：工作时间和原因。由您的经理批准。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: For a recovery: the employee's advance

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 用于信息技术或指定的人：雇主的一名员工

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 上班或下班，按您当前状态
